description: Source code for USB device endpoint management in Zephyr OS, including functions for enabling, disabling, setting halts, and handling control endpoint buffers.

methods.name: usbd_ep_enable
methods.description: Enables a USB endpoint with specified descriptor and updates endpoint bitmap.

methods.name: usbd_ep_disable
methods.description: Disables a USB endpoint, clears bitmap, dequeues pending transfers, and yields.

methods.name: usbd_ep_ctrl_set_zlp
methods.description: Sets Zero Length Packet flag if conditions are met for control transfers.

methods.name: usbd_ep_ctrl_buf_alloc
methods.description: Allocates buffer for control endpoint if endpoint is a control endpoint.

methods.name: usbd_ep_ctrl_enqueue
methods.description: Enqueues control transfer buffer, handling suspension and ZLP setup.

methods.name: usbd_ep_buf_alloc
methods.description: Allocates buffer for a specific endpoint.

methods.name: usbd_ep_enqueue
methods.description: Enqueues a buffer for transmission on a specified endpoint.

methods.name: usbd_ep_buf_free
methods.description: Frees a buffer associated with an endpoint.

methods.name: usbd_ep_dequeue
methods.description: Dequeues a buffer from an endpoint.

methods.name: usbd_ep_set_halt
methods.description: Sets halt condition on an endpoint and updates internal state.

methods.name: usbd_ep_clear_halt
methods.description: Clears halt condition on an endpoint and updates internal state.

methods.name: usbd_ep_is_halted
methods.description: Checks if an endpoint is halted.
